# Copilot instructions — modernization (sibling)

> Generated by doc-and-modernize. **Do not treat this as a replacement** for
> `.github/copilot-instructions.md` (caveman). Merge by hand if you want
> Copilot to auto-load these commands. See `MODERNIZATION_PLAN.md` and
> `ARCHITECTURE.md`.

`agent-crew` is **already lit** (Python 3.12, uv, pytest). Safety rung **L3**.
CI workflow exists; **enforcing** required checks is a human GitHub Settings
step. Never launch Streamlit or any UI server.

## Commands

| Action | Command |
| --- | --- |
| Install | `uv sync --all-groups` |
| Run UI (human only) | `uv run streamlit run streamlit_app.py` |
| Tests | `uv run pytest` |
| One file | `uv run pytest tests/test_phase1.py` |
| One test | `uv run pytest tests/test_phase1.py::test_safe_file_rejects_escape` |
| Lint | `uv run ruff check .` |
| Format / check | `uv run ruff format .` / `uv run ruff format --check .` |
| Types | `uv run ty check src/` |
| Audit | `uv run pip-audit .` |
| Build | `uv build` |
| Hooks | `prek run --all-files` |

CI (`.github/workflows/ci.yml`) runs format → lint → ty → pytest → pip-audit
and a prek job on push/PR. **Enforcement is manual** (GitHub → Settings →
Branches → required checks `check` and `hooks`).

## Phase gating

A phase is not done until `MODERNIZATION_PLAN.md` exit criteria are recorded.

- **Lit (`agent_crew`):** `uv run ruff check .`, `uv run ty check src/`,
  `uv run pytest` must pass on the phase PR.
- **Do not** add Streamlit launch to CI.
- Never require a UI e2e gate (component has not crossed UI testability).

## Decisions

- Keep CrewAI + LangGraph. Do not rewrite the orchestrator.
- Phase 1 = `protect_tests` + mutation probe. Phase 4 real-repo is deferred.
- Update `MODERNIZATION_PLAN.md` markers: ✅ / ⏭️ / 🗑️.

## Branching

Trunk: `master` (unborn until first commit). One branch per phase
(`phase-N-short-name`). Merge to trunk before the next phase. Do not stack
phase PRs. If topology or commands change, update this file, `README.md`, and
`ARCHITECTURE.md` in the same PR.
